properties.name: Newfoundland-Labrador Shelves Federal Marine Bioregion (Canada)
properties.source: Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO), Marine Planning and Conservation Directorate, Federal Marine Bioregions
properties.note: Reprojected from Canada Albers Equal Area Conic (NAD83) to WGS84, the Albers edges densified at 2 km first. Interior rings that are islands are dropped: land is excluded by sst_daily holding ocean cells only, not by the geometry. The one interior ring kept is Saint-Pierre et Miquelon's French maritime zone, which is water the region does not cover. Parts holding no 0.05-degree cell centre are dropped. This is Canada's own marine-planning framework, not a maritime limit: the dataset describes its boundaries as fuzzy and revisable on ecosystem grounds. Longitudes are 0-360, as everywhere else in this project.
